protocol.selection_rule: among fixed quote-update and clock-time windows, minimize validation Brier score after fitting on the earliest development dates; break exact ties toward quote-update windows, then shorter windows
protocol.refit: refit the selected specification on all pre-test dates, then score the final dates once
protocol.final_evaluation: compute final-period scores only for the selected fixed horizon and the pre-specified adaptive reference; rejected fixed candidates retain null test metrics
protocol.target: direction of the next same-session mid-price change
protocol.sample: post-event states after a best price or size update
protocol.ofi_transform: top-of-book OFI divided by current displayed depth and mapped by 2*atan(x)/pi
protocol.price_spell_window: increments strictly after the event that established the current mid-price; retained as the adaptive reference and excluded from fixed-window selection
protocol.quote_update_window: current and preceding best-price-or-size OFI increments
protocol.clock_window: best-price-or-size OFI increments with timestamps in (signal_time - horizon, signal_time]
